The proposed allocation would be based on a conservative estimate to maintain a portfolio duration below 10 years and adhere to the specified allocation constraints. I must emphasize that the request to include BB-rated bonds cannot be accommodated due to the fundamental requirement to only invest in investment-grade bonds.
